title: Rosmarinic Acid Targets Gamma-Radiation-Induced Cerebellar Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, and Apoptosis via Interplay Between Nrf2/HO-1 and NF-κB/NLRP3 Pathways: A CombinedandStudy.
snippet: Radiotherapy (RT) is a crucial modality in the treatment of malignancies; however, its use may inadvertently cause cerebellar injury due to its neurotoxic effects. This study aimed to evaluate the radioprotective potential of rosmarinic acid (RA) against gamma radiation (GR)-induced cerebellar toxicity in experimental rats. Forty rats were randomly divided....
